nom: Oak Essentials Renew Face Polish Gentle Exfoliator

avis.texte: Renew Face Polish is super gentle and the best exfoliator I have tried on my sensitive skin. I have no redness after using it, and my face doesn't feel dry.
I have been using Oak Essentials products for the last year and I am very pleased with all of their results.
I really love this exfoliating face polish, it makes my face feel great.
This product is awesome- it provides such a glow up after use. It doesn't dry out your skin but gets rid of the dull layer.

avis.titre: This is the best face scrub I've used to date
avis.texte: I've used some of the top brands when it comes to face scrubs and this one is by far my favorite. It does the job without leaving your face irritated or thinned out. The scrub is pretty sharp but it doesn't feel rough and there's so much moisture included
This provides effective exfoliation yet it's gentle. I use this twice a week and I love it!

I love this exfoliating wash! It feels granular without being scratchy, and it works so well. I had been using the R&F one, which I also like, but this one is more sandy and I feel like it's more gentle
I am very sensitive skin, this works so well and I don't have a reaction at all. Love it.
My esthetician saw an improvement of my skin by using this product! I think it's a must have for your skin care routine once or twice a week. I'd prefer a different scent, though.

I love oak essentials and love both of this product. I received a sample and after a few uses, I had two people comment on how nice my skin was looking so it was a no brainer to get the bottle. It is gentle of my very sensitive skin and pairs beautifully with the moisture rich balm.
Oh my gosh!! My face has never felt smoother! I've tried other exfoliants but this one shines!!

avis.titre: I love my new face polish
avis.texte: I love my new face polish! I can see a difference in my skin after adding this product to my routine .

avis.titre: Has definitely improved my skin texture
avis.texte: I've seen a noticeable difference in my skin after using this product and it's very effective. The only thing that would make this product even better is getting rid of the smell (despite being unscented it does have a weird smell to it)!
Love the Renewed Face Polish! It makes my face smooth and refreshed feeling every time I use it! Thank you Oak Essentials!
A great face polish that is gentle and effective! My skin always feels so smooth after using it.
This product does exactly what it says it will do. It is also very gentle on the skin.
This face scrub is gentle & effective – absolutely works, even if you have sensitive skin.
Gentle exfoliator for the face, leaves skin feeling smooth and ready to allow serum absorption
This scrub is so great! It's so gently but still feels like it's doing its job. There isn't much fragrance at all which is nice. It's a very creamy scrub so it's not harsh at all.
Not too gritty or harsh on the skin. It does not strip away all of the natural oils or leave my face feeling dry.
Absolutely love this product my skin looks and feels wonderful!!

avis.titre: great on my skin year round
avis.texte: my skin is super dry in the winter and this works great on it - doesn't irritate it or dry it out.
Love it! Makes my skin so smooth without being too harsh or drying
So many products claim to shrink pores. This actually does! All while leaving a soft clean finish.
Love the scrub, great add in a couple of times a week to get that fresh start.

This exfoliant is the best I've tried - and I've tried many! It polishes with the right amount of "scrub", and the base is luxurious. The product rinses cleanly and easily, leaving behind polished perfection.
Great polish- leaves skin refreshed without drying it out. Love the scent as well.
My skin feels deeply clean but not irritated afterwards. Love the refined, minimal-but-effective approach.
I exfoliate twice a week with this face polish and there is nothing more refreshing for my skin. It makes my skin feel so soft and clean after. Highly recommend!
This face scrub is gentle but very, very effective! Melts into the skin beautifully and leaves my face feeling clean and hydrated. A little goes a long way.

The Oak Essentials Renew Facial Polish has completely replaced all of my previous facial scrubs. I grew up believing that if you couldn't feel a product working, it wasn't doing anything, but that often left my skin stripped and dry. This facial polish changes that. It delivers both physical and chemical exfoliation without the harsh burn or dryness, and instead leaves my skin feeling nourished, smooth, and refreshed.
My skin has never felt better! I love all the Oak Essential products and have tried them all!
Just the right amount of exfoliation without being too harsh!
Love this on occasion throughout the week for a clean healthy glow!

I have been using this in conjunction with the Pore Minimizing Mask and the results have been as promised. The scent is as wonderful as the product itself. I sometimes will just spot treat a particular area! Love it!

avis.titre: Shocked by how well this works!
avis.texte: I can't believe how my skin feels after using this!! I got a sample and when I first applied it, I felt like it wasn't doing anything because it was so gentle… until I rinsed my face off and WOAH. My skin felt so smooth and new! Literally felt like I'd gotten a peek. Even my husband uses it and loves it! I keep buying it over and over again.
This face scrub does what it claims! It cleans the skin, removes dead skin cells, leaves my skin feeling bright, smooth, and soft!

I use this 3 times a week to polish my skin and it helps keep my skin texture feeling soft while giving my skin the feeling of being deeply cleaned. I've tried other scrubs before that have felt too harsh or grainy but just a little bit of this goes a long way.
I love the renew face polish. It makes my skin feel soft and refreshed.

avis.titre: Complexion is more clear and vibrant
avis.texte: After going into menopause my face began getting acne. Something I have never had not even as a teenager. In three days as part of my daily routine my acne spots were not visible. I have been using 3 times a week.
My face feels very clean and smooth when I use. Wish there was more cushion around the beads. Just need to be gentle when you apply.
This product is amazing and makes your skin feel so smooth after using it. I can't get enough of it.
I wasn't a big fan of this. The grit was a little too coarse for my preferences. It is unscented, but not in a pleasant way.
Was excited to try it and was not dissappointed. Left my skin feeling amazing
I've never felt a lighter face scrub; and I've tried a lot. This one really took care of my skin

avis.titre: I can always trust Oak Es
avis.texte: I can always trust Oak Essentials to make a great product. This is another one that has done wonders for my dry skin.
I've used many scrubs before, but now I can feel good about what I'm putting on my skin
Love this face polish. I have tried so many, and this one strikes the perfect balance of being effective at refreshing and moisturizing at the same time. It isn't too abrasive and isn't too soft.

avis.titre: Does the job with no breakouts
avis.texte: I love this scrub. I've tried many and this makes my skin feel/look clean but not stripped. I use it every 2-3 days to boost skin turnover since acids are too disruptive to my skin's barrier. Scrub smells good, good texture, no irritation, no breakouts!
I use something gentler in the winter, but during the summer when you have to wear a lot of heavy sunscreen this is really a nice cleanse.
Love this - alternates with milk cleanser very well and particularly great after the beach!
Don't hesitate on this - I waited and should have tried it immediately. Just what I needed for my routine and dry skin. Love!
use this 2x a week to help keep my skin clear and it's just so lovely
I have nearly all the OE products and this one is my favorite - super gentle, easy and smells incredible!
This makes my skin feel so soft! Not overwhelming like some scrubs can be - it feels gentle and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and soft!
This is a gentle yet effective exfoliating scrub. I plan to use it once or twice a week and follow it up with the restorative mask.
This product is very efficient. It not only removes makeup residue but intensely removes any other impurities leaving a clean smooth complexion.
This formula is great! Not too harsh but does its job effectively removing makeup and drawing out impurities.
This is the only scrub I've been using for months now. It's a fabulous exfoliator and my skin feels awakened afterward.
Renew face polish is also a must in my face routine… it scrubs off dead dry skin and leaves my face luxuriously soft. I love this product and I highly recommend
Love everything about this brand, this makes face soft and fresh!

I have always used masks in my skin care routine. This mask blows me away!! My skin feels awesome after I use it. A little bit goes a long way. I feel it has helped with the fine lines around my eyes. Compared to other masks, there is no chemical smell -it smells fresh. I feel I'm doing something good for my skin and it's repaying me with a healthy glow. Will be a staple in my weekly routine for the foreseeable future. Everything I have tried from OE I have loved.
This is amazing! Skin feels smooth and less flakey. I wish the smell were a bit sweeter.
Wow was I pleased to find this! With my sensitive skin I have struggled to find a gentle scrub/exfoliate- this is the one! Felt so refreshed afterwards.
Great facial scrub, truly gets all dead skin cells, dry skin, and rough parts off your face and leave it so smooth. Plus the scent is just like a spa!
I love this scrub. It's revitalizing and not harsh on my sensitive skin.
Perfect scrub - not too "grainy" so gentle enough for my sensitive skin. Leaves face feeling soft, smooth and refreshed. Improved texture and resilience.
I love this face polish. It's exfoliating without being too harsh. I use it once or twice a week and it keeps my skin looking bright!
Received this as a gift from my friend and I am IN LOVE. Leaves your skin feeling so soft. 10/10
Literally the BEST scrub I've ever used! It doesn't overstrip my skin and pairs great with the moisture balm.
I love this product! I use it a few times a week to refresh my skin, help remove dead skin, and deep clean pores. Highly recommend!

This product is really incredible! I have been dealing with irritated & damaged skin for about 3-4 months now slowly working on getting my skin barrier restored. I have been using very gentle products in my routine & hesitated trying anything new either as I feared it could cause more irritation. However, I believe in exfoliation as a needed step, but needed the right product for it. This face polish delivered with an overhead - my skin keeps improving, visibly & to the touch, and I don't think I would get to these results without the face polish. Bonus point - my very picky boyfriend also loved this product and said positive things about it!

I was not expecting to love this. I got it as a free gift with the purchase of another product from Oak Essentials. I used it in the shower after washing my face, scrubbed it on for about 30 seconds and rinsed it off with warm water. Not to be dramatic, but my skin really does feel so soft and looks brighter after just one use.
Best exfoliating product! Does the job without irritating the skin
Amazing product for sensitive skin! My skin feels and looks so soft just after one use. Not harsh like most exfoliating products.

Love the face polish I've never been able to use anything exfoliating on my face Because it is too rough on my face. My skin turns red super quickly. I definitely can use this even daily. Sometimes I just apply a little to my essential face wash an scrub up together!!! Thank you
Love how it makes my skin feel extra clean without harshness.
I recently received a sample of this and will be purchasing the full size immediately. It is wonderful! The exfoliation if gentle yet effective.
I have skin that gets irritated very easily. this scrub is gentle and effective. I only use once a week.
Love, love, love this delicate scrub!! Perfect amount of gentle exfoliation. Leaves my skin feeling soft and looking fresh!!
A perfect addition to my skincare routine! Deep cleansing but gentle on skin
I have sensitive skin and this works great on my skin. My skin feels polished and smooth after using without any irritation.

I love the how soft and smooth my skin feels every time I use this product. It's gentle enough to use every day - if I'm in a hurry and don't get the opportunity to use this product, I notice the difference. It's a must-do in my daily routine and is worth every penny. I'm a huge fan.
I keep this in the shower and use once or twice a week, then the moisture mask. I'm so glad they came up with this product!

I love this polish because it does not make the skin dry or red after using. It feels so clean after washing with it. I have drier skin this time of the year so I just use it once a week. In the summer 2 times a week. Love the smell!
